judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD planning/red-test phase and did not implement any of the production changes. Specifically, `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (`ajv` dependency) are completely untouched, meaning the 3 newly added tests in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when run. Additionally, it created `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the required `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`, omitted more than half of the required unit and orchestrator tests, and failed to update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `CHANGELOG.md`. Only a partial spec file and an internal `.lore/dod.md` checklist were committed.
